scope: Theorem 1 of the manuscript “Snaky in 21 Maker moves” (preprints/Snaky-in-21-Maker-moves-September-25-2026/article.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 187 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 e5ce107fdc4ec77f), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 1. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: In this game, there is one globally legal Maker policy that completes an allowed copy of S within at most 21 actual Maker claims against every legal continuation of Breaker. Equivalently, extend the policy by fresh claims after an earlier win: its Maker set after claim 21 contains a target whenever the first 20 Breaker replies are legal.
